definitions.explanation: The alternating periods of success and failure, prosperity and adversity in life or business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{浮|う}き{沈|しず}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Life has its ups and downs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{浮|う}き{沈|しず}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{浮|う}き{沈|しず}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: After many ups and downs, they finally succeeded.

notes:
{浮|う}き{沈|しず}み combines "floating" and "sinking" to express life's fluctuations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {浮|う}き{沈|しず}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there are ups and downs
- {浮|う}き{沈|しず}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: the fluctuations are intense
- {浮|う}き{沈|しず}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to experience ups and downs

USAGE:
Used for both personal life experiences and economic/business contexts. Implies resilience through difficult times.
